Golf communities in Dubai are known for their magnificence, lush green views, and luxurious lifestyle. Overlooking a golf course, residences in these communities feature an upscale lifestyle with state-of-the-art amenities. The best part? Golf lovers can easily find membership opportunities in the golf clubs as well.

If you fancy living in such a community and leading an ultra-exclusive lifestyle, we’re presenting you with a list of the top 5 golf communities in Dubai. Take a look at these communities to help you finalise the one that suits your needs and fits your budget range.

Top 5 Golf Communities Located in Dubai

1. Dubai Hills Estate

Also known as Dubai Hills, it is one of the most popular golf communities in Dubai. It occupies a prime location along the Al Khail Road (E44), next to Al Barsha South and offers luxury properties for sale and rent in a range of configurations. You can find luxury apartments, townhouses and villas here, in different layouts vis-à-vis the number of bedrooms.

Crafted by Emaar, Dubai Hills Estate offers easy accessibility to residents because of its location. The community provides residents with a sense of tranquillity and freshness because of the green areas and walkways it entails. A massive area of more than 1.4 million sq. m. is dedicated to open spaces and parks.

The focal feature, undoubtedly, is the 18-hole golf course it is built around. Other than that, there’s the huge Dubai Hills Malls. The community enjoys close proximity to other popular localities such as Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai and Emirates Hills, making it easily accessible.

2. DAMAC Hills

Covering a massive area of 42 million sq. ft., Damac Hills is located in Dubailand. It is a project of DAMAC Properties and houses a variety of mix-use properties. One of the popular golf communities, it lies on Al Qudra Road (D63), close to Mudon, Remraan and other areas located along the highway, including Town Square, Arabian Ranches 2, The Sustainable City.

Other than a championship golf course, the area is home to a multi-purpose arena and a private parkland. Residential properties in DAMAC Hills come in different types and configurations. You can find options for apartments, villas and townhouses in varying layouts. The villas, in particular, enjoy massive popularity among residents because of their design and affordability. Furthermore, the community also offers numerous retail, dining, leisure and wellness facilities.

3. Emirates Hills

Emirates Hills is a gated community famous for the upscale lifestyle it offers. Part of Emirates Living Projects, it is bordered by The Springs, The Lakes and The Meadows, while Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Village Circle and Jumeirah Lake Towers are also located nearby.

Emirates Hills houses the Montgomerie Golf Club. Most housing units in this area overlook this amazing golf club. Residents here enjoy a host of facilities such as swimming pools, state-of-the-art fitness centres, and there are abundant BBQ areas and parking spaces as well.

Known as the Beverly Hills of Dubai, this community has plenty of open spaces that add an element of freshness and serenity to the surroundings. It features villas and standalone homes that are unprecedented when it comes to design, structure and layout. Since it is a freehold area, it is well-known among expats. You can find many foreign nationals owning luxury villas here and enjoying the exclusive lifestyle this development offers.

It is a family-friendly, master-planned community that promises luxurious living. Featuring elegant neighbourhoods, it is well-liked by pet owners since there are dedicated pet parks. While being close to some popular areas, Emirates Hills also offers a peaceful and quiet lifestyle, which is no less than a blessing in a busy city like Dubai.

4. Jumeirah Golf Estates (JGE)

Next in the list of best golf communities in Dubai, Jumeirah Golf Estate is another freehold area in Dubai where you can find expats living with their families. It offers an upscale community lifestyle and houses a mix of residential properties.

Although it features apartments and townhouses, it’s the villas in JGE that enjoy massive popularity. Set in clusters, they feature a distinct design, while the architecture is unparalleled as well. Furthermore, each villa in this community is laced with modern facilities and amenities.

Most properties in JGE overlook the renowned Fire and Earth golf courses. They enjoy global recognition as the DP World Tour Championship is held here. Apart from the golf courses, another prominent feature of this community is the natural landscape covering an area of 1,100 hectares, thereby providing a sustainable healthy environment. All these features come together to give JGE a serene ambience. Furthermore, there’s The Norman Clubhouse, the country club of the community. It is extremely famous for its dining facilities, a swimming pool, a rooftop barbecue and other exceptional facilities.

As a gated community nestled along Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, it provides residents with modern facilities and several other family-friendly amenities. Neighbouring communities include Sports City, Jumeirah Village Circle and International Media Production Zone (Dubai Production City).

5. Arabian Ranches

One of the most well-known golf communities in Dubai, Arabian Ranches is further divided into 15 sub-communities. Since it was among the first few suburban freehold areas in the emirate, many expats have purchased villas here. Even now, it is considered one of the top areas of interest among buyers.

It is a luxurious community which is evident from the modern villas it nestles. From style to layout and design, each villa in The Ranches exudes class and elegance. Overlooking the Arabian Ranches Golf Club, these villas come in different configurations, including 4, 5 and 6-bedrooms.

Developed by Emaar, the community also has townhouses, more suitable for couples and smaller families. It spans over 1,650 acres and has lush green spaces in abundance. As it is a self-contained, gated community, residents can find everything they require within the area. Dubai Polo Equestrian and Club is also located here.

It is also known for its accessibility. Thanks to the easy road and transport options, it’s easy to reach this community from major parts of the emirate.

This concludes our list of the best golf communities in Dubai. If you are looking for a residential property in any of them, feel free to contact Provident Estate. We can help you find the best properties for sale or rent in the aforementioned and other golf communities located in the emirate as well.
